title: Define adapter interface and refactor existing transformers
description: Create a TypeScript Adapter interface that all output adapters implement. Refactor existing transformToCSS and transformToTailwindV4 to implement the interface. Preserve existing function signatures as wrappers (no breaking changes).
acceptance_criteria: Adapter interface: transform(tokens: FlatToken[], options: AdapterOptions): string
Existing transformToCSS and transformToTailwindV4 refactored to implement the interface
No breaking changes to public API (existing function signatures preserved as wrappers)
Unit tests for adapter contract compliance

evidence.context: Uniform adapter interface enables community output formats
